test_title: PYST 34: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A class of 93 students took a Physics test. 10 students had an average score of 90. The remaining students had an average score of 75. What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume base average = 75.

Extra score from 10 students = 10 × (90 − 75) = 150.

Distributed extra score over 93 students = 150 ÷ 93 ≈ 1.61.

Final Average = Base + Distributed extra = 75 + 1.61 = 76.61.

**∴ The correct answer is 76.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Total students = 93 | Group 1 = 10 students (Avg 90) | Group 2 = 83 students (Avg 75).

Formula Used: Average = Total Sum ÷ Number of Students

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fc5a01d55b5dde4f6164e7f9b57f7bdea7d48fe55aa97214de54f2ab5532fa0.png] 

⇒ Sum of scores of 10 students = 10 × 90 = 900

⇒ Number of remaining students = 93 − 10 = 83

⇒ Sum of scores of 83 students = 83 × 75 = 6225

⇒ Total sum of scores for the class = 900 + 6225 = 7125

⇒ Class Average = Total Sum ÷ Total Students = 7125 ÷ 93

⇒ Class Average ≈ 76.6129...

⇒ Rounded Average = 76.6

**∴ The correct answer is 76.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

The combined average A = (n₁a₁ + n₂a₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the quantity and a is the individual average.

Net Deviation Principle

Sum of deviations from the actual average is always zero. This helps in finding missing values or correcting errors in data.

Rounding Rule

To round to one decimal place, check the second decimal digit; if it is 5 or more, increase the first decimal by 1, otherwise leave it unchanged.
